---
title: "Gallery: navigation & structure"
description: >
  Tier 3 layout — tabs, accordion, collapsible, pagination, carousel,
  scroll-area, resizable panels and the sidebar family — rendered live.
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
for (p in c("_common.R", "../_common.R", "vignettes/_common.R"))
  if (file.exists(p)) { source(p); break }
```

These components arrange the rest. Like the overlays, they run client-side, so
the tabs switch, the accordion expands and the carousel slides right here. Those
with an `inputId` also report the active pane through `input$id`. See
[Layout & composition](layout.html) for putting them together into a full app
shell.

## Tabs

Switch between panes. The active value is `input$id`; drive it from the server
with `update_shad_tabs()`.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_tabs(
    "demo_tabs", selected = "account",
    shad_tab("account", "Account",
      tags$div(style = "padding-top:0.75rem",
        shad_p("Update your account details here."))),
    shad_tab("password", "Password",
      tags$div(style = "padding-top:0.75rem",
        shad_p("Change your password here."))),
    shad_tab("team", "Team", icon = "circle",
      tags$div(style = "padding-top:0.75rem",
        shad_p("Manage your team members.")))
  )
)
```

## Accordion

Vertically stacked, collapsible sections. `type = "single"` keeps one open;
`"multiple"` allows many.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_accordion(
    "demo_acc", type = "single", collapsible = TRUE, value = "a1",
    shad_accordion_item("a1", "Is it accessible?",
      shad_p("Yes. It follows the WAI-ARIA disclosure pattern.")),
    shad_accordion_item("a2", "Is it styled?",
      shad_p("Yes. It comes with sensible defaults you can theme.")),
    shad_accordion_item("a3", "Is it animated?",
      shad_p("Yes — height transitions come for free."))
  )
)
```

## Collapsible

A single show/hide region behind any trigger.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_collapsible(
    "demo_coll", open = FALSE,
    trigger = shad_button("Show advanced options", variant = "ghost",
      icon = "chevrons-up-down", icon_position = "right"),
    tags$div(style = "padding:0.75rem 0;display:grid;gap:0.5rem",
      shad_muted("These options are hidden until requested."),
      shad_switch("adv_a", label = "Enable experimental features"))
  )
)
```

## Pagination

Page controls that report the current page as `input$id`.

```{r}
demo(shad_pagination("demo_pg", pages = 8, selected = 3))
```

## Carousel

A horizontal slider with optional dots and arrows.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  tags$div(
    style = "max-width:22rem;width:100%;margin:0 auto",
    do.call(shad_carousel, c(
      list("demo_car", show_dots = TRUE),
      lapply(1:4, function(i) shad_carousel_item(
        shad_card(shad_card_content(
          tags$div(style = "display:grid;place-items:center;height:8rem;font-size:2rem;font-weight:600", i)))))
    ))
  )
)
```

## Scroll area

A styled, fixed-height scroll container.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_scroll_area(
    height = "10rem",
    tags$div(style = "padding-right:1rem",
      shad_h4("Tags", style = "margin-top:0"),
      tagList(lapply(1:20, function(i) tagList(
        shad_p(paste("Item", i), style = "margin:0.35rem 0"),
        shad_separator()))))
  )
)
```

## Resizable

Draggable split panes. Drag the handle to resize.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  tags$div(style = "height:12rem",
    shad_resizable(
      "demo_rz",
      shad_resizable_panel(default_size = 40,
        tags$div(style = "display:grid;place-items:center;height:100%", "Sidebar")),
      shad_resizable_handle(),
      shad_resizable_panel(default_size = 60,
        tags$div(style = "display:grid;place-items:center;height:100%", "Content"))
    )
  )
)
```

## Sidebar layout

The full app shell: a collapsible sidebar with grouped, badged nav items and a
main region. `input$id` reports `{collapsed, mobileOpen, active}` — observe
`input$id$active` for the selected item.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  tags$div(style = "height:18rem;border-radius:var(--shad-radius-lg);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--shad-border)",
    shad_sidebar_layout(
      "demo_shell",
      sidebar = shad_sidebar(
        header = tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center;padding:0.25rem",
          shad_icon("terminal"), tags$strong("Acme")),
        shad_sidebar_group("Platform",
          shad_sidebar_item("home", "Home", icon = "circle", active = TRUE),
          shad_sidebar_item("inbox", "Inbox", icon = "mail", badge = "3"),
          shad_sidebar_item("search", "Search", icon = "search")),
        shad_sidebar_group("Account",
          shad_sidebar_item("settings", "Settings", icon = "more-horizontal"))
      ),
      main = tags$div(style = "padding:1rem",
        tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center;margin-bottom:0.75rem",
          shad_sidebar_trigger(), shad_h4("Home", style = "margin:0")),
        shad_p("Toggle the sidebar with the trigger. Resize the window to see it collapse."))
    )
  )
)
```
